title: Cloud Scan
lead: A structured assessment of cloud adoption maturity — identifying gaps, risks and opportunities across governance, architecture and operations.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The Cloud Scan assesses an organisation's current cloud adoption against best practices and maturity models. It examines cloud governance, security posture, cost management, operational model and architecture to produce a prioritised set of improvement recommendations and a cloud roadmap.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Used in ITOM engagements to establish the baseline for cloud strategy and cloud transformation. The scan outputs directly inform the platform and technology dimensions of the target operating model.

items.desc: Policies, guardrails and accountability structures for cloud usage.
Cloud security posture, identity management and regulatory compliance.
FinOps maturity, cost visibility and right-sizing.
Monitoring, incident management and automation in the cloud.
Landing zone design, workload suitability and multi-cloud strategy.
